dissection.mechanism: Every node's inverted CALM baseline nulls TOO well: nd_proper 0.87-0.999 for every section and every true state — the template attractor collapses all settled states to within ~1-13% residual of the CALM direction per section, so state identity is NOT in the post-cancellation residual (best residual matches <= ~0.2, swamped by CALM's nd_proper in the composition; every section votes CALM 16/16). The whole-cavity chain reads the identity from the rectified autocorrelation signature instead. Follow-up queued (not run): node stores referenced to the aggregate bank baseline with LUT-style delta matching (parallel component kept), per section.

G4_power_honesty.power_ledger_matched_config: see top-level power_ledger.matched (residual-in-second-cavity + bleed ratio for the matched configuration)
G4_power_honesty.note: arbitrary units, NOT joules. Conservative: tapped energy counted on top of the through-flow dissipation it was sampled from (double-counts the tapped fraction).

power_ledger.definitions: arbitrary units, NOT joules. P_in = mean settled through-flow power sum_s ||a_settled,s||^2 over the 16 trials. passed/reflected = (1-RHO)*P_in (never sampled). coupled = RHO*A(mu)*P_in enters the node arm; tapped_by_nodes = sum_s coupled_s * ND_proper_s (power the nodes cancel against their inverted proper baselines); power_residual_second_cavity = sum_s coupled_s * (1 - ND_proper_s) (power left standing in the inverted cavity after translation); bleed = RHO*(1-A(mu))*P_in (sampled, lost to impedance mismatch — neither usefully tapped nor left standing accounted). bleed_ratio = bleed / P_in.
